name: ambient_light_compat
description: Issue #80: 11x11 roofed room, a door in the south wall (NOT a bare gap -- a bare gap makes Room.UsesOutdoorTemperature true, which makes EaveCells.IsEave classify the whole room as an eave, so it never reaches CapOcclusion's cap terms at all: this was live-diagnosed as the reason an earlier version of this scenario showed zero pixel diff under every toggle, room-wide, with no lamps, so any roofed-edge brightening comes only from sky glow. Run this scenario twice at the harness level -- once with only CelestialLighting active (baseline: ambient_ground_glow/ambient_sky_fraction both pin 0 regardless of the SetFeature toggle below, since AmbientLightCompat.SkyFractionAt is 0 whenever the mod isn't installed), once with the 'Ambient Light' workshop mod (f1995.ambientlight, id 3574400467) also loaded. Whether Ambient Light is present is not ours to flip mid-scenario, but our own compat flag is: within the Ambient-Light-loaded run, the indoor_glow_passthrough SetFeature toggle below captures the reported bug (off: interior reads dark despite a nonzero ambient_ground_glow) against the fix (on) in one pass, at the near-door cell AmbientLightDoorCellProbe reads. Forces the Realistic preset first: Cinematic's shipped-default MinIndoorBrightness (0.50) sets CapOcclusion's ceiling to 0.5, which is MORE restrictive than the AL term's own ceiling (1 - ambientLightSkyFraction) whenever that fraction is under 0.5 -- i.e. almost always -- so on Cinematic the compat toggle cannot move a pixel regardless of whether it works, the same class of masking CLAUDE.md's night-brightness-clamp memory already documents for §7a.
